resources.string: Not available yet. Phone-call replacement needs a VOICE_COMMUNICATION route that the root bridge does not provide, so the switch is hidden.
Make or answer a phone call using the earpiece. Conversion starts automatically when connected. The microphone is released while waiting.
Choose your voice and turn on virtual mic, then make or answer a phone call.
Sending only your converted voice to the phone call. Incoming audio stays unchanged.
Connect a regular phone call first, then return here to start conversion.
Use the phone earpiece. Speakerphone, Bluetooth and headsets are not supported. Changing the route during conversion keeps the original voice blocked and ends the call.
This experimental phone-call mode currently supports only the tested Samsung S23+ (SM-S916N) with compatible system audio controls.
The phone microphone is muted. Unmute it in the Phone app before starting conversion.
Another call audio feature is using the microphone controls. Turn off live translation and try again.
Audio processing or monitoring was interrupted, so call termination was requested. The original microphone is restored only after the call is confirmed to have ended.
Call termination or microphone restoration could not be confirmed. Original voice blocking will not be released. End the call manually in the Phone app.
Automatic microphone restoration could not be confirmed. End this call before trying again.
